retention_helper.source:
"""Preserve both failed eligibility assessments and every completed observation."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re

TASK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = TASK.parents[2]
REMOTE = '<task>'
OUT = REPO / 'bench/results'
STEM = 'ownership-qualification-diagnostic-eligibility-failure-20261023'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())

def portable(v):
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return v.replace(str(TASK), '<task>').replace(str(REPO), '<repository>').replace(REMOTE, '<task>')
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return [portable(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        pairs = [(portable(k), portable(x)) for k, x in v.items()]
        assert len({k for k, _ in pairs}) == len(pairs)
        return dict(pairs)
    return v

def encode(v):
    return (json.dumps(portable(v), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()

def doc(p):
    return dict(sha256=sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size, content=read(p))

pending = {}
platforms = {}
for platform in ('Darwin', 'Linux'):
    parent = (TASK / 'sources/qualification-transport-repair/target/tmp/ownership-cells'
              if platform == 'Darwin' else TASK / 'linux-qualification/transport-repair')
    directory = parent / ('qualification-diagnostics-Darwin' if platform == 'Darwin' else 'diagnostics')
    result_path = directory / 'results.json'
    result = read(result_path)
    calls = result['calls']
    plan_path = parent / f'qualification-diagnostics-{platform}.json'
    plan = read(plan_path)
    assert result['plan_sha256'] == sha(plan_path)
    assert result['status'] == 'failed' and len(calls) == result['native_calls_started'] == 30
    assert result['native_calls_reused'] == 1 and result['native_calls_executed_here'] == 29
    assert result['failures'] == [dict(message='positive actual baseline construction/finalist omission missing', type='ValueError')]
    assert result['retries'] == 0 and result['exclusions'] == []
    assert calls[-1]['cell'] == 'ownership-inactive-zero-t4'
    assert result['schedule'] == plan['schedule']
    references = {}
    for index, call in enumerate(calls):
        assert call['status'] == call['oracle'] == 'passed'
        assert all(call[k] == plan['schedule'][index][k] for k in ('cell', 'arm', 'repeat', 'workers'))
        head, log = directory / call['target'], directory / call['log']
        assert sha(head) == call['result_sha256'] and sha(log) == call['log_sha256']
        raw = read(head)
        assert raw.pop('columns') == [] and raw == call['raw_result']
        if index:
            timers = re.findall(r'^NATIVE_SECONDS=([0-9.]+)$', log.read_text(), re.M)
            assert len(timers) == 1 and float(timers[0]) == call['seconds']
            assert call['timing_field'] == 'NATIVE_SECONDS' and 0 < call['seconds'] <= 120
        else:
            assert call['timing_field'] == 'observed_process_span_upper_bound'
            assert call['maxrss_bytes'] is None
        ref = call.get('reference')
        if ref:
            head_path = directory / (ref['path'] + '.json')
            assert sha(head_path) == ref['head']
            references[ref['path']] = dict(head=doc(head_path), npz_sha256=ref['outputs'],
                                          npz_retained_on='original execution host')
    parts = []
    restored = []
    for start in range(0, len(calls), 10):
        name = f'{STEM}-{platform.lower()}-calls-{start // 10 + 1:02d}.json'
        body = dict(schema=1, kind='complete-diagnostic-call-objects', platform=platform,
                    first_schedule_index=start, calls=calls[start:start + 10])
        encoded = encode(body)
        restored.extend(json.loads(encoded)['calls'])
        pending[name] = encoded
        parts.append(dict(path=name, bytes=len(encoded), sha256=hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(), calls=10))
    assert restored == portable(calls)
    observer = directory / 'host/host-observations.jsonl'
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in observer.read_text().splitlines()]
    for event in events:
        if 'raw' in event:
            event['raw_field_sha256'] = {k: hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest() for k, v in event.pop('raw').items()}
    assert result['host']['isolation_ok'] and not result['host']['errors']
    summary = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != 'calls'}
    extra = dict()
    previous = 2 if platform == 'Darwin' else 20
    if platform == 'Darwin':
        outer = TASK / 'qualification-transport-diagnostics-Darwin-check.json'
        extra['outer_check'] = doc(outer)
        assert read(outer)['exit_code'] == 1 and read(outer)['source_hashes_unchanged_after']
        charged_here = math.ceil(max(read(outer)['elapsed_s'], result['continuation_elapsed_s']))
        job_log = TASK / 'qualification-transport-diagnostics-Darwin.log'
    else:
        account = parent / 'diagnostics-accounting.txt'
        fields = {k: v.strip() for k, v in (line.split(None, 1) for line in account.read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split(None, 1)) == 2)}
        assert fields['jobnumber'] == '8266048' and fields['failed'] == '0' and fields['exit_status'] == '1'
        assert fields['slots'] == '28' and fields['hostname'] == 'scc-uf3.scc.bu.edu' and fields['ru_wallclock'] == '46'
        extra['accounting'] = dict(raw_sha256=sha(account), fields=fields)
        extra['submission'] = doc(TASK / 'qualification-transport-diagnostics-submission.json')
        extra['hold_observation'] = 'qhold reported modified hold, but terminal accounting establishes the job had started and executed. The hold did not prevent execution; no unexecuted-cancellation claim is made.'
        extra['scheduler_seconds'] = dict(original=2700, original_failure=34, this_failure=46, remaining=2620)
        charged_here = math.ceil(result['continuation_elapsed_s'])
        job_log = parent / 'diagnostics-job.log'
        assert 'QUALIFICATION_TRANSPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED_AFTER f7594b314aa730a49926b819d25fe4781e89fcb2' in job_log.read_text()
    assert charged_here == (6 if platform == 'Darwin' else 37)
    mechanisms = {}
    for cell in ('ownership-nonmovers-t4', 'ownership-hubs-t4', 'ownership-inactive-zero-t4'):
        group = [c for c in calls if c['cell'] == cell]
        assert len(group) == 5
        if cell == 'ownership-inactive-zero-t4':
            assert len({c['fingerprint'] for c in group}) == 1
            assert len({c['worker_signature'] for c in group}) == 1
        mechanisms[cell] = [dict(arm=c['arm'], repeat=c['repeat'], ownership=c.get('ownership_diagnostic'), cells=c.get('cell_diagnostic')) for c in group]
    platforms[platform] = dict(raw_results_sha256=sha(result_path), raw_results_bytes=result_path.stat().st_size,
        summary=summary, complete_call_parts=parts, exact_call_roundtrip=True, plan=doc(plan_path),
        references=references, observer=dict(raw_sha256=sha(observer), events=events, host=doc(directory / 'host/host.json')),
        job_log_sha256=sha(job_log), mechanism_observations=mechanisms,
        budget=dict(original=2400, prior_charge=previous, this_charge=charged_here,
                    cumulative_charge=previous + charged_here, remaining=2400 - previous - charged_here), **extra)

record = dict(schema=1, kind='ownership-qualification-diagnostic-eligibility-failure', date='2026-10-23',
    platforms=platforms, original_failures_remain_failed=True, candidate_runtime_changed=False,
    diagnosis='The no-intercept two-categorical-FE control cannot materialize loaded_rhs. Both accepted and candidate loaders require an appended intercept or the separate single-absorbed-slope case. The diagnostic instead required positive moments for every W4 non-cache-boundary body. Its hypothetical360-byte expectation was incorrect.',
    correction_scope='Derive construction eligibility from the frozen layout contract. Require no construction and zero omission for the inactive no-intercept control; retain positive score ownership and all exact/scoped science, resource and transaction gates. Preserve positive omission on eligible bodies and W4 construction on cache-boundary controls.',
    observed_positive_omission=dict(nonmovers_w4_bytes=288, hubs_w4_bytes=480, repeats_per_arm=2),
    independent_reviews=['High-effort reviewer verified source eligibility and all30 Mac head/log hashes; narrow harness expectation repair justified.', 'Bounded Astra independently confirmed c16 and candidate eligibility and matching inactive fingerprints; retain all30 observations and execute only untouched entries.'],
    prospective_continuation=dict(reused_calls_per_platform=30, new_calls_per_platform=50,
        unchanged_schedule_total_per_platform=80, original_physical_hosts_required=True,
        offline_prefix_revalidation_required=True, no_native_resampling=True,
        before_execution='A separately committed source, schedule and remaining-budget amendment must be frozen.'),
    historical_records=[dict(path=p.name, sha256=sha(p)) for p in [
        OUT / 'ownership-qualification-diagnostic-transport-failure-20261023.json',
        OUT / 'ownership-qualification-transport-repair-freeze-20261023.json']],
    final_qualification_timing_calls=0, qualification_passed=False, activation_qualified=False,
    retention_helper=dict(sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), source=Path(__file__).read_text()))
pending[STEM + '.json'] = encode(record)
for name, data in pending.items():
    assert len(data) < 1000000 and not any(b'/' + s in data for s in (b'Users/', b'projectnb/', b'home/johannes'))
    assert not (OUT / name).exists()
for name, data in pending.items():
    with (OUT / name).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(data)
print(json.dumps({name: dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) for name, data in pending.items()}))
